newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.594 bln stg in wk to June 18.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.594 bln stg in wk to June 18.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.594 billion stg in the week to June 18 from 25.450 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis M0 rose to 25.488 billion stg from 25.380 billion.
Notes and coins in circulation rose to 25.394 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.389 billion the previous week and fell to 25.288 billion from 25.319 billion on an unadjusted basis.
